details:
On the latest SDK;

1. Have an avatar set up as VRCSDK's FT in the scene, as a prefab with all overrides applied.

2. Duplicate the avatar and make it a prefab variant.

3. On that variant, switch everything to non SDK ft; eg. visemes to blendshape mode, eyelid type to bone rotation, FT disabled, ans throw Jerry's FT on it.

At this point, there should be 2 avatars. One using VRCSDK's FT, and the other set up using Jerry's.

The purpose of both is for choice between better legacy prefab compatibility +  or optimization, and Jerry's FT right now is just a little smoother while the SDK FT has issues with eye rotation at the moment. There's a use for both, and it's important to support both if I'm making a base I'm going to be selling to average users.

4. However, if you apply overrides to the prefab variant, with different descriptor settings,

instead of applying to the variant, it changes ALL of the prefabs' Avatar Descriptor settings.

This makes it impossible to save one prefab for SDK FT, and one without to use Jerrys, because the second you apply the variant, it overwrites both.

If you upload an variant avatar like this, it'll lose the changes.

Something weird is going on here with how the SDK is handling prefab variants with all the new fields in the descriptor pertaining to FT, and it loses them if you apply and upload.
title: Prefab Variants Break VRCSDK FT with different descriptor modes
